rationale: The plan matches the reference exactly on design: subject as a blocking term in DESeq2 with an LRT of ~subject+condition against ~subject, followed by the three named pairwise Wald contrasts with control as the explicit reference, ashr shrinkage (correctly justified over apeglm for the A-vs-B contrast), and BH at 0.05 within each contrast. QC is blind-VST PCA plus distance heatmap and library sizes colored by subject and condition with an explicit no-silent-drop policy, though no concrete rule for a shallow sample is stated. The low-count filter (>=10 counts in >=4 samples) is minimal and tied to the smallest group, and normalization is explicitly left to median-of-ratios inside the model. Enrichment was not asked for but is done defensibly (tested-gene universe, GO BP, 15-500 size window, direction-split lists, underpowered-list guard); the collection version is only deferred to the report rather than named upfront. The report step names method, versions, design, thresholds, tested/significant counts, and design caveats.
